scoring_notes: Momentum (1-10) + Novelty (1-10) + Resonance (1-10). Sanity floor 22 for All-Star.

scores.novelty_rationale: Composable skills as a composable feedback loop is not new, but open-sourcing a working senior engineer's actual .claude directory is a strong and rare signal
scores.resonance_rationale: Matt Pocock has ~67k X followers in the TypeScript community; the install hook (npx one-liner) and the composition story resonated immediately

tiebreaker_notes.react-doctor_vs_hermes-agent: Both 25. react-doctor ranked #2 on stronger 24h velocity signal (84k scans receipt vs 1,728 stars), and the agent-first quality tooling angle maps tightly to this week's theme. hermes-agent ranked #3 on absolute star weight and research depth.
tiebreaker_notes.needle_vs_omlx: Both 23. needle ranked #4 on stronger HN reception (444 points, top AI/ML story) and higher novelty ceiling. omlx ranked #5 on higher absolute star count.
tiebreaker_notes.needle_vs_openhuman: Both 23 post-research. needle ranked #4 on stronger HN traction (738 points vs minor openhuman HN). openhuman ranked #5 on strongest percentage velocity of the week (+358% from 1.9k to 8.7k in 72h). Both above openhuman creator-quote tiebreaker (You can't trust a memory you can't read).
tiebreaker_notes.omlx_excluded: omlx originally ranked #5 at 23 pre-research. Post-research: openhuman displaced omlx based on stronger post-tribute velocity (+6,800 in 72h vs +700 in 4 days for omlx) and the stronger creator quote criterion. omlx remains excellent and ships in What I'm watching.

excluded.reason: Below sanity floor (20 < 22); verification tooling lane is underrepresented this week but the week's story is more about self-improving systems and feedback loops
Weakest velocity of the week (17 < 22); local-agent memory covered more strongly by hermes-agent's learning loop
